review.algorithm_assessment: After the initial shared green interval, the earliest possible resynchronization is the shortest signal full cycle. Scan integral seconds through five hours inclusive and require every phase to be strictly before its five-second yellow segment.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
